author: China Insights
description:
While global attention focused on high-level talks, a different story unfolded behind the scenes. From subtle reactions and unexpected interactions to moments of tension and humour, the visit offered a glimpse into the human side of diplomacy.

In this episode, we revisit some of the most talked-about moments — including reactions during official ceremonies, interactions between high-profile figures, and situations that drew attention from media on both sides.

By looking beyond formal statements, we explore how these small details can sometimes reveal larger dynamics in international relations.

title: Behind the Scenes of the Trump–Xi Meeting: The Moments You Didn’t See I China Insights
